description: Corrected topology-matched test using curated topology, edge-trimming test of whether the GES signal lives in the anchor core or its annotated edges, and figure of boundary-definition sensitivity
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, math, json
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d=json.load(open("uniprot_omm.json")); seqs=d["seqs"]; tmsd={k:[tuple(x) for x in v] for k,v in d["tms"].items()}
F=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_features.csv"); W=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_robustness.csv")
GES=dict(A=1.6,R=-12.3,N=-4.8,D=-9.2,C=2.0,Q=-4.1,E=-8.2,G=1.0,H=-3.0,I=3.1,L=2.8,K=-8.8,M=3.4,F=3.7,P=-0.2,S=0.6,T=1.2,W=1.9,Y=-0.7,V=2.6)
ms=lambda s: float(np.mean([GES[a] for a in s if a in GES]))
def auroc(a,b): return float(np.mean([[1.0 if y>x else (0.5 if y==x else 0.0) for y in b] for x in a]))

M=F.merge(W[["gene","GES_win19","win19_seq"]],on="gene")
# core = UniProt anchor trimmed by 3 residues at each end
cores=[]
for _,r in M.iterrows():
    s0,e0=tmsd[r.acc][0]; seq=seqs[r.acc]
    core=seq[s0-1+3:e0-3]
    cores.append(dict(gene=r.gene, core=core, GES_core=ms(core),
                      edges=seq[s0-1:s0-1+3]+seq[e0-3:e0], GES_edges=ms(seq[s0-1:s0-1+3]+seq[e0-3:e0])))
C=pd.DataFrame(cores); M=M.merge(C,on="gene")

print("=== Where does the GES difference live: anchor core vs annotated edges? ===")
print(M[M.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent'])][["gene","mim_class","topology","anchor","GES","GES_core","GES_edges","GES_win19"]].round(3).to_string(index=False))
for col in ["GES","GES_core","GES_edges","GES_win19"]:
    sub=M[M.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent'])]
    a=sub[sub.mim_class=='dependent'][col].values; b=sub[sub.mim_class=='independent'][col].values
    A=auroc(a,b); U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(b,a,alternative='two-sided')
    print(f"  {col:10s} AUROC(ind>dep)={A:.3f}  p={p:.4f}")

print("\n=== Topology-matched using CURATED topology (single-span only; Ugo1/Om14/Fzo1/Scm4 excluded) ===")
S=M[(M.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent']))&(~M.topology.isin(['multispan']))]
print(S[["gene","topology","mim_class","GES","GES_core","GES_win19"]].round(3).to_string(index=False))
for col in ["GES","GES_core","GES_win19"]:
    a=S[S.mim_class=='dependent'][col].values; b=S[S.mim_class=='independent'][col].values
    A=auroc(a,b); U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(b,a,alternative='two-sided')
    print(f"  {col:10s} AUROC={A:.3f}  exact p={p:.4f}  (n={len(a)} dep vs {len(b)} ind, min attainable p={2/math.comb(len(a)+len(b),len(b)):.4f})")
print("NOTE: UniProt annotates only ONE transmembrane segment for Ugo1 (Q03327) although the primary literature treats it as a multispan protein; curated topology used here.")

M.to_csv("mim_anchor_core_vs_edge.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
sub=M[M.mim_class.isin(['dependent','independent'])]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.4))
col={"dependent":"#c0392b","independent":"#2471a3"}
ax=axes[0]
defs=["GES","GES_core","GES_win19"]; labs=["UniProt anchor","anchor core\n(edges trimmed 3+3)","most hydrophobic\n19-mer (boundary-free)"]
for j,(c,l) in enumerate(zip(defs,labs)):
    for _,r in sub.iterrows():
        ax.scatter(j+(0.12 if r.mim_class=='independent' else -0.12), r[c], color=col[r.mim_class], s=55, zorder=3)
aurocs=[]
for c in defs:
    a=sub[sub.mim_class=='dependent'][c].values; b=sub[sub.mim_class=='independent'][c].values
    aurocs.append(auroc(a,b))
for j,A in enumerate(aurocs):
    ax.text(j,2.9,f"AUROC {A:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("mean GES hydrophobicity (kcal/mol per residue)")
ax.set_title("The separation depends on how the anchor is defined")
ax.set_ylim(-1.8,3.3)
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color=v,label="MIM-"+k) for k,v in col.items()],fontsize=9,loc="lower left")

ax=axes[1]
mods=["GES threshold\n(UniProt anchor)","GES threshold\n(boundary-free 19-mer)","multispan OR low GES\n(two-factor)","null: always\nMIM-dependent"]
ba=[0.733,0.583,0.783,0.500]; acc=[0.769,0.538,0.846,0.769]
x=np.arange(4); ax.bar(x-0.18,acc,0.36,label="LOO accuracy",color="#95a5a6")
ax.bar(x+0.18,ba,0.36,label="LOO balanced accuracy",color="#c0392b")
ax.axhline(0.5,ls=":",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(3.3,0.515,"chance",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(mods,fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylim(0,1.0)
ax.set_ylabel("leave-one-out performance (n=13)")
ax.set_title("No classifier beats the trivial baseline by much")
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
